The Oriental Insurance Company Limited conducted the Phase-II (Mains) exam for the Administrative Officer (Generalist & Hindi Officer) positions on 28th February, 2026. The official OICL AO Result announced on 30th April 2026 with the roll numbers of candidates provisionally shortlisted for the interview stage. Individuals who are Qualified are advised to verify the eligibility regarding age, qualifications & caste before attending the interview as call letters will be made available on the official website http://orientalinsurance.org.in . While the merit list is now public individual marks & specific performance data will only be disclosed after the final selection process is completed fully.

OICL AO Result 2026 Out @orientalinsurance.org.in

The OICL AO Result was released on 30th April 2026 officially after the completion of the Phase-II evaluation process. The board published a list of roll numbers of candidates who have provisionally qualified for the interview stage. The announcement covers both the Generalist & Hindi (Rajbhasha) Officer disciplines. Candidates can verify the roll numbers against the PDF to confirm the eligibility for the final selection round now.

The release of the OICL AO Result of the Phase-II exam conducted on 28th February 2026. Thousands of aspirants across India appeared for the e test & the merit list shows the performers. Qualifying candidates must now prepare for the interview which is the final problem in the selection process. It is important to note that the result is provisional & subject to the verification of all eligibility criteria

OICL AO Mains Result Out– Click Here to Download PDF

OICL AO Mains Result Download link

To access the OICL AO Mains Result 2026 candidates must use the official recruitment website provided by the company. The direct download link for the PDF containing the roll numbers of shortlisted candidates is active under the official website. This document is a public file allowing aspirants to check the qualifying status without needing login credentials initially.

OICL AO Mains Result: Direct Link Available Here!

OICL AO Result 2026: Overview

The recruitment for Administrative Officers (Scale-I) is managed by the HR Department of The Oriental Insurance Company Limited. Following the Phase-II exam the company has released the list of roll numbers for candidates who have qualified for the next stage. Below is an overview table of the recruitment status & dates :

Particulars Details
Recruitment Body Oriental Insurance Company Limited (OICL)
Post Name Administrative Officer (AO) Scale-I
Total Vacancies 300 (285 Generalist + 15 Hindi Officers)
Tier-II (Mains) Exam Date 28 February 2026
Result Date  30 April 2026 (Phase-II (Mains)
Mode of Application Online
Selection Process Prelims → Mains → Interview
Official Website orientalinsurance.org.in

How To Download OICL AO Mains Result 2026?

Downloading the OICL AO Result is a simple process that needs visiting the official website & navigating to the specific recruitment notice. Candidates should see that they download the correct PDF based on the post they applied for either Generalist or Hindi Officer. Having a digital & physical copy of the result is recommended for future reference during the interview & document verification rounds. Follow the steps provided as under to get the result:

  1. Visit the Website: Open the browser & go to orientalinsurance.co.in.
  2. Go to Careers: Click on the tab of “Careers” located on the homepage.
  3. Find the Notice: Look for the link named “Direct Recruitment of AO (Generalist & Hindi Officer) Exercise-2025”.
  4. Open Result Link: Click on the link for “List of Shortlisted Candidates for Interview”.
  5. Search Roll Number: Use the ‘Find’ function (Ctrl+F) to enter the roll number.
  6. Download PDF: Save the file to the device for offline access.

What details are mentioned on the OICL AO Phase 2 Result 2026?

The OICL AO Result PDF contains information for transparency & clarity for all examinees. It is organized roll-number-wise rather than by merit rank to maintain a standard format for the initial shortlist. Candidates should check that the details match the records given during the application process. Any clerical mistakes found in the document should be brought to the notice of the department.

  • Roll Numbers of Qualified Candidates
  • Exam Name
  • Post Name (AO)
  • Stage of Qualification (Mains)
  • Instructions for Next Stage

What Next After OICL AO Mains Result Declaration?

Once the OICL AO Result is declared shortlisted candidates must shift the focus to the final selection phase which is the personal interview. The company will soon release a link for downloading Interview Call Letters which will contain the specific date, time & venue for the interaction. Candidates are advised to keep the original documents ready for verification as any discrepancy can lead to immediate disqualification.

  1. Download Call Letter: Monitor the official website for the interview invitation link.
  2. Verify Eligibility: See that the candidate meets all age, qualification & caste requirements as per the original notification.
  3. Prepare for Interview: Study current insurance trends, company history & general awareness.
  4. Documents: Prepare sets of photocopies & original certificates for educational qualifications & category proof.
  5. Final List: Marks & final selections will be disclosed only after the entire process concludes.

What is the message for candidates who have not qualified in the OICL AO Exam?

If the roll number is not in the OICL AO Result it is important to remember that competitive exams are a test of persistence as much as knowledge. While the result may be disappointing, it provides a benchmark for the current preparation level & identifies areas for growth. The insurance sector releases recruitment notifications & the experience gained during this exercise will be invaluable for the next attempt.

Candidates who did not qualify should wait for the release of the individual OICL AO scorecard to analyze the section-wise performance. The data will help to understand whether one needs to improve speed, accuracy or conceptual clarity. Use the time to refine the strategy, focus on weaker subjects & return stronger for upcoming bank & insurance exams.

OICL AO Qualifying Marks 2026

The qualifying marks for the OICL AO Result are the minimum scores a candidate must achieve to be considered for the next stage of recruitment. The marks are determined based on several factors including the number of vacancies, the difficulty level of the Phase-II paper & the overall performance of the candidate pool. Candidates must clear both the sectional & overall cut-offs to find the names in the provisional shortlist.

Category Estimated Qualifying Range (%)
General / UR 45% – 50%
OBC (NCL) 40% – 45%
SC / ST 35% – 40%
PwBD 30% – 35%

OICL AO 2026 Score Card

The OICL AO scorecard is an individual performance report that will be released only after the final selection process is completed. Unlike the result PDF which only shows roll numbers the scorecard gives the actual marks obtained in each section of the Phase-II exam. The document is essential for all candidates whether qualified or not to get a clear picture of the standing in the competition.

To download your OICL AO scorecard candidates will eventually need to log in using the registration number & date of birth once the link is active on the portal. It is an important tool for self-assessment & a record of the academic achievement in the recruitment cycle.

OICL AO 2026 Cut Off

The following table below provides an estimation of the OICL AO cut-off marks needed to clear the OICL AO Result for different categories. The marks are calculated based on the difficulty level of the Mains exam & the total number of vacancies.

OICL AO Mains Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. Is OICL AO Result 2026 Released?

Ans: Yes the OICL AO Result for the Phase-II exam was released on 30th April 2026. Candidates can check the shortlisted roll numbers on the official website

Q2. How to check OICL AO result 2026 from official website?

Ans: Visit orientalinsurance.co.in, go to the “Careers” section & click on the “List of candidates qualified for Interview” link under the AO recruitment exercise

Q3. What is the Qualifying Marks for OICL AO 2026?

Ans: While exact marks are not public yet candidates must achieve the minimum percentage set by the company to pass both the sectional & overall thresholds.

Q4. What is the official website of OICL AO Result 2026?

Ans; The official website for all recruitment updates & results is orientalinsurance.co.in.

Q5. When will the interview call letters be available?

Ans: The link for downloading interview call letters will be made available shortly on the OICL careers website for all shortlisted candidates.
